Nehru-era historical images — public domain
============================================

All images in this folder are in the PUBLIC DOMAIN and were obtained from
Wikimedia Commons. They are historical photographs from 1947 (the Indian
independence / Partition period), published in India well over 60 years ago
and/or works of the Government of India Photo Division — public domain under
Indian copyright law and marked "Public domain" on Wikimedia Commons.

They are used here as historical context for a public-domain reading room of
M.O. Mathai's Nehru-age memoirs.

File                     Source (Wikimedia Commons)
----                     --------------------------
swearing-in.jpg          "Lord Mountbatten swears in Jawaharlal Nehru as the first
                         Prime Minister of free India on Aug 15, 1947"
midnight-session.jpg     "Jawaharlal Nehru during the midnight session of the
                         Constituent Assembly of India held on 14 and 15 August 1947"
independence-day.jpg     "Lord Mountbatten, Edwina Mountbatten and Jawaharlal Nehru at
                         the first Independence Day celebrations in New Delhi"
partition-refugees.jpg   "Gandhi and Nehru and refugees" (downscaled to ~1000px)
kashmir-1947.jpg         "Jawaharlal Nehru and Sheikh Abdullah in Srinagar"
new-flag.jpg             "A news bureau photo of Nehru and the new flag"

Each file's Commons page (search the title) carries the full public-domain tag
and provenance. No rights reserved; attribution to the original archives is a
courtesy, retained here.
